on_when.equals: value === gate.expected (null is replaced by gate.null_means first)

resolution.blocking: Gates without `blocking: false` decide on/off. `blocking: false` gates (all per_event gates, and some client flags that only narrow a feature) are reported as reasons but never turn a feature off.
